    seq: int                  # monotonic position in the capture
    recorded_at_ns: int
    client_id: str
    request_id: str
    operation: str            # submit | read | read_range | status | reconcile

    latency_ns: int
    params: dict

class OperationRecorder:
    """Wraps a ledger client and appends one structured record per observed call."""

    def __init__(self, service: LedgerService):
        self.svc = service
        self.records: list[OperationRecord] = []

    def _emit(self, *, client_id, request_id, operation, attempt,
              outcome, latency, params, index=None, term=None,
              entry_hash=None, commit_index=None, error=None) -> OperationRecord:
        rec = OperationRecord(
            seq=len(self.records) + 1, recorded_at_ns=time.time_ns(),
            client_id=client_id, request_id=request_id, operation=operation,
            attempt=attempt, outcome=outcome, index=index, term=term,
            entry_hash=entry_hash, commit_index=commit_index,
            latency_ns=latency, params=params, error=error)
        self.records.append(rec)
        return rec

    def submit(self, txn, attempt=1) -> OperationRecord:
        t0 = _now(); r = self.svc.submit(txn); dt = _now() - t0
        return self._emit(
            client_id=txn.client_id, request_id=txn.request_id, operation="submit",
            attempt=attempt, outcome=r.status, latency=dt,
            params={"op": txn.op, "key": txn.key,
                    "value": txn.value.decode() if txn.value else None},
            index=r.index, term=r.term, entry_hash=r.entry_hash,
            commit_index=r.commit_index, error=r.error)

    def read(self, client_id, index, attempt=1) -> OperationRecord:
        t0 = _now(); e = self.svc.read(index); dt = _now() - t0
        return self._emit(
            client_id=client_id, request_id=f"read-{index}", operation="read",
            attempt=attempt, outcome="ok" if e else "not_found", latency=dt,
            params={"index": index}, index=e.index if e else None,
            term=e.term if e else None, entry_hash=e.hash if e else None,
            commit_index=self.svc.commit_index)

    def read_range(self, client_id, a, b, attempt=1) -> OperationRecord:
        t0 = _now(); es = self.svc.read_range(a, b); dt = _now() - t0
        return self._emit(
            client_id=client_id, request_id=f"range-{a}-{b}", operation="read_range",
            attempt=attempt, outcome="ok" if es else "not_found", latency=dt,
            params={"start": a, "end": b, "returned": len(es)},
            index=es[-1].index if es else None,
            commit_index=self.svc.commit_index)

    def reconcile(self, client_id, request_id, attempt=1) -> OperationRecord:
        t0 = _now(); r = self.svc.reconcile(client_id, request_id); dt = _now() - t0
        return self._emit(
            client_id=client_id, request_id=request_id, operation="reconcile",
            attempt=attempt, outcome=r.status if r else "not_found", latency=dt,
            params={"resolves": request_id},
            index=r.index if r else None, term=r.term if r else None,
            entry_hash=r.entry_hash if r else None, commit_index=self.svc.commit_index)

    def status(self, client_id="ops") -> OperationRecord:
        t0 = _now(); s = self.svc.status(); dt = _now() - t0
        return self._emit(
            client_id=client_id, request_id="status", operation="status",
            attempt=1, outcome="ok" if s["healthy"] else "degraded", latency=dt,
            params={"members": len(s["members"])}, commit_index=s["commit_index"])

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ exports
    def to_jsonl(self) -> str:
        return "\n".join(json.dumps(asdict(r), default=str) for r in self.records)

    def to_frame(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
        df = pd.DataFrame([asdict(r) for r in self.records])
        df["hash8"] = df["entry_hash"].str[:8]
        return df

    recorded_at_ns: int
    client_id: str

    attempt: int              # client-side retry counter

    latency_ns: int
    params: dict

class OperationRecorder:
    """Wraps a ledger client and appends one structured record per observed call."""

    def __init__(self, service: LedgerService):
        self.svc = service
        self.records: list[OperationRecord] = []

    def _emit(self, *, client_id, request_id, operation, attempt,
              outcome, latency, params, index=None, term=None,
              entry_hash=None, commit_index=None, error=None) -> OperationRecord:
        rec = OperationRecord(
            seq=len(self.records) + 1, recorded_at_ns=time.time_ns(),
            client_id=client_id, request_id=request_id, operation=operation,
            attempt=attempt, outcome=outcome, index=index, term=term,
            entry_hash=entry_hash, commit_index=commit_index,
            latency_ns=latency, params=params, error=error)
        self.records.append(rec)
        return rec

    def submit(self, txn, attempt=1) -> OperationRecord:
        t0 = _now(); r = self.svc.submit(txn); dt = _now() - t0
        return self._emit(
            client_id=txn.client_id, request_id=txn.request_id, operation="submit",
            attempt=attempt, outcome=r.status, latency=dt,
            params={"op": txn.op, "key": txn.key,
                    "value": txn.value.decode() if txn.value else None},
            index=r.index, term=r.term, entry_hash=r.entry_hash,
            commit_index=r.commit_index, error=r.error)

    def read(self, client_id, index, attempt=1) -> OperationRecord:
        t0 = _now(); e = self.svc.read(index); dt = _now() - t0
        return self._emit(
            client_id=client_id, request_id=f"read-{index}", operation="read",
            attempt=attempt, outcome="ok" if e else "not_found", latency=dt,
            params={"index": index}, index=e.index if e else None,
            term=e.term if e else None, entry_hash=e.hash if e else None,
            commit_index=self.svc.commit_index)

    def read_range(self, client_id, a, b, attempt=1) -> OperationRecord:
        t0 = _now(); es = self.svc.read_range(a, b); dt = _now() - t0
        return self._emit(
            client_id=client_id, request_id=f"range-{a}-{b}", operation="read_range",
            attempt=attempt, outcome="ok" if es else "not_found", latency=dt,
            params={"start": a, "end": b, "returned": len(es)},
            index=es[-1].index if es else None,
            commit_index=self.svc.commit_index)

    def reconcile(self, client_id, request_id, attempt=1) -> OperationRecord:
        t0 = _now(); r = self.svc.reconcile(client_id, request_id); dt = _now() - t0
        return self._emit(
            client_id=client_id, request_id=request_id, operation="reconcile",
            attempt=attempt, outcome=r.status if r else "not_found", latency=dt,
            params={"resolves": request_id},
            index=r.index if r else None, term=r.term if r else None,
            entry_hash=r.entry_hash if r else None, commit_index=self.svc.commit_index)

    def status(self, client_id="ops") -> OperationRecord:
        t0 = _now(); s = self.svc.status(); dt = _now() - t0
        return self._emit(
            client_id=client_id, request_id="status", operation="status",
            attempt=1, outcome="ok" if s["healthy"] else "degraded", latency=dt,
            params={"members": len(s["members"])}, commit_index=s["commit_index"])

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ exports
    def to_jsonl(self) -> str:
        return "\n".join(json.dumps(asdict(r), default=str) for r in self.records)

    def to_frame(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
        df = pd.DataFrame([asdict(r) for r in self.records])
        df["hash8"] = df["entry_hash"].str[:8]
        return df
